brief: Six tactile pickup tiers: common cloth and wooden pack contact; uncommon adds a small metal clasp; rare adds clear glass contact; epic adds a brief resonant plate tail; legendary adds staggered glass and plate closure; cursed uses a dark, dry wood and soft-body closure. Four recorded performances per bank, no electronic chime. Material-specific contacts remain audible.
